source.excerpt: If you knew how much work went into it, you would not call it genius
trail: This exact sentence has not been pinned to a Michelangelo work or contemporary account. Wikiquote lists it as disputed, citing a 2001 Usenet appearance and Lori Rozakis’s 2007 presentation guide rather than a Renaissance source. Source and attribution evidence ↗

Those modern appearances document circulation, not Michelangelo’s authorship. A similar longer saying about hard work and mastery is also unsourced; resemblance does not authenticate either version. Read the supporting source ↗
